# #442 — BRAIN-1: the brain skill documents a retired transport, a hardcoded host, and a stale tool table

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: documentation
Created: 2026-07-29T18:23:37Z
Updated: 2026-07-29T18:23:37Z

---

The canonical `_ob/skills/brain/` skill is organized around the retired operator
CLI bridge — a transport that is **retired and hook-blocked for Claude Code**.
Every recipe in it is a call Claude cannot make, which is why recent sessions
have ignored the skill entirely.

## Measured 2026-07-29

| Defect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Retired transport is the spine | every recipe uses the retired CLI bridge; Claude reads the skill and finds nothing executable |
| Hardcoded endpoint, 3 places | `SKILL.md:10`, `_DOCS/procedure.md:16`, `ob.json:17` all name `http://10.71.1.21:3100/mcp`. That is core01, not this machine. The client is env-driven (`$OPENBRAIN_BASE_URL`) |
| Stale tool table | the table claims 46 tools "verified 2026-07-02"; the live server has **63** (17 added, 0 removed — purely additive) |
| Drift check violates a hard rule | `_DOCS/procedure.md` writes to `/tmp`, and shells the retired CLI to do it |

Missing from the table are the tools this project actually runs on:
`agent_context_pack`, `agent_reflex_pointers`, `citation_recall`,
`ingest_raw_turn`, `working_set_append`, `recovery_wal_*`, `decompose_entry`,
`operator_doctor`, and the `*_source` family.

## Scope

Mostly deletion, and it is **downstream of #438/#439** — trimming the text first
produces a well-written skill that describes an empty room.

- Delete the tool table. 63 rows go stale the day the 64th ships; that is the
  loop being re-lived. A live `tools/list` is never wrong.
- Delete the drift check. It exists only to maintain the table, and writes to
  `/tmp`.
- Demote the operator-CLI recipes to a Codex/operator appendix; put the
  Claude/Python client first.
- **No hardcoded endpoint anywhere** — not `10.71.1.21`, not `127.0.0.1`. The
  environment is the only source.
- Keep and grow `workflows/` — verbs, not transport.

## Also

Trim for Claudex/Codex reuse once proven here. Runtime-specific content should be
confined to one section so porting is deletion rather than a rewrite.

Design: `_plans/canon-always-known.md`
